e.title_en: A2ii (Access to Insurance Initiative): an inclusive-insurance initiative working with insurance supervisors, now led by CGAP
e.title_hk: A2ii（Access to Insurance Initiative）：面向保險監管者的普惠保險倡議（現由 CGAP 主導）
e.summary_hk: 與保險監管者合作的普惠保險倡議（2009 年起）：現由 CGAP 主導，推行《普惠保險宣言》、創新實驗室、監管地圖等
e.summary: 与保险监管者合作的普惠保险倡议（2009 年起）：现由 CGAP 主导，推行《普惠保险宣言》、创新实验室、监管地图等
e.summary_en: An inclusive-insurance initiative working with insurance supervisors since 2009, now led by CGAP, promoting the Inclusive Insurance Declaration plus an Innovation Lab and a regulations map
e.body:
**A2ii（Access to Insurance Initiative，保险可及性倡议）** 是**面向保险监管者的普惠保险倡议**，自 **2009 年**起运作，**现由 CGAP（世界银行集团的普惠金融扶贫协商小组）主导**。本条目与 [[microinsurance-network]] 同属本轮**普惠保险**取向——实测池内 **A2ii 与 CGAP 相关条目均为 0**，而池内**普惠/小额保险**与**监管能力建设**两条线此前都缺入口。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：**`a2ii.org/en` 实测已整站呈现为 CGAP 站点**（页面标题实测为 **「Access to Insurance Initiative (A2ii) | CGAP」**），**页面正文原文**：**「The Access to Insurance Initiative (A2ii) works with insurance supervisors to promote inclusive and responsible insurance, thereby reducing vulnerability. Since 2009, A2ii has played a key role in disseminating knowledge, supporting peer learning, and facilitating dialogue between s[upervisors…]」**；页面另实测出现 **「Key A2ii initiatives led by CGAP」**（**由 CGAP 主导的 A2ii 关键倡议**），并明确提到 **Championing the Inclusive Insurance Declaration, advocating for its adoption within national financial inclusion strategies**（**推动《普惠保险宣言》被纳入各国普惠金融战略**）以及 **（IAIS）** 与 **Innovation Lab、Cape Town Declaration、Fema-Meter、Regulations Map** 等具体项目名；对应集合页 `cgap.org/topics/collections/access-to-insurance-initiative` **HTTP 200（56.2KB）**。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「普惠保险的监管侧」这一形态**——[[microinsurance-network]] 给**市场侧与景观研究**，A2ii 给**规则与监管能力建设侧**；其**工作对象是保险监管者**（而非保险公司），因此产出的多是**监管诊断、同行学习与工具**，对做**新兴市场保险监管、普惠保险政策**方向的学生是**直接对口**的来源；页面中实测出现的 **Regulations Map（监管地图）**、**Cape Town Declaration（开普敦宣言）**、**Innovation Lab** 等，都是**可检索的具体抓手**。**② 一个重要的结构性事实**：**A2ii 现已成为 CGAP 的一部分**——因此**引用时应写明「A2ii（由 CGAP 主导）」**，否则读者会找不到独立站点（`a2ii.org` 已并入 CGAP 域名体系）。**③ 与既有条目配套**——监管框架见 [[iais-icp]]、[[iais-gimar]]，监管数据见 [[irdai-market-statistics]]、[[philippines-insurance-commission]]、[[ira-kenya]]、[[acaps-morocco]]、[[ojk-insurance-statistics]]，保险机制见 [[openimis]]、[[bima-mcp]]、[[aegis-parametric]]、[[parametric-insurance-demo]]、[[agrisky-ai]]，缺口与巨灾侧见 [[swiss-re-sigma]]、[[climate-conditioned-cat]]、[[dfa-climate-datasets]]。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**页面标题、正文原文（含 2009 年起点、与监管者合作的定位、「由 CGAP 主导」与《普惠保险宣言》等表述）与集合页的存在**，**但未下载任何工具、诊断报告或数据**；**②** A2ii 的**原独立站点内容是否已全部迁入 CGAP、以及是否保留独立出版物库，本次未核实**；**③** 页面提示站点使用 **AI 自动翻译**（原文「This website uses AI-powered automated translation… may not always be fully accurate」），**故非英文版本的表述需谨慎**；**④** 本词条**不主张**该站提供精算工具或数据集。**核实说明**：`a2ii.org/en`（56.2KB）与 `cgap.org/topics/collections/access-to-insurance-initiative`（56.2KB）HTTP 200 实测并读取正文原文；**未下载任何工具或报告**。
e.body_en:
**A2ii (Access to Insurance Initiative)** is **an inclusive-insurance initiative working with insurance supervisors**, running **since 2009** and **now led by CGAP** (the Consultative Group to Assist the Poor, part of the World Bank Group). With [[microinsurance-network]], it belongs to this round’s **inclusive insurance** direction — a measured search found **zero A2ii- and CGAP-related entries**, while both the **inclusive/microinsurance** and **supervisory capacity-building** threads lacked an entry point.

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): **`a2ii.org/en` now presents as a CGAP site** (the page title measures as **"Access to Insurance Initiative (A2ii) | CGAP"**), and its **body text reads verbatim**: "**The Access to Insurance Initiative (A2ii) works with insurance supervisors to promote inclusive and responsible insurance, thereby reducing vulnerability. Since 2009, A2ii has played a key role in disseminating knowledge, supporting peer learning, and facilitating dialogue between s[upervisors…]**"; the page also shows "**Key A2ii initiatives led by CGAP**" and states its work includes **"Championing the Inclusive Insurance Declaration, advocating for its adoption within national financial inclusion strategies"**, with mentions of **(IAIS)** and specific projects such as an **Innovation Lab**, the **Cape Town Declaration**, **Fema-Meter** and a **Regulations Map**; the corresponding collection page `cgap.org/topics/collections/access-to-insurance-initiative` measured **HTTP 200 (56.2KB)**.

For RIAA: **① it adds the "regulatory side of inclusive insurance" form** — [[microinsurance-network]] supplies **the market side and the landscape study**, A2ii supplies **the rules and supervisory capacity side**; its counterparties are **insurance supervisors** rather than insurers, so its outputs are largely **supervisory diagnostics, peer learning and tools**, directly relevant to students working on **emerging-market insurance regulation and inclusive-insurance policy**; the **Regulations Map**, **Cape Town Declaration** and **Innovation Lab** measured on the page are **concrete, searchable handles**. **② One important structural fact**: **A2ii is now part of CGAP** — so **citations should read "A2ii (led by CGAP)"**, otherwise readers will not find a standalone site (`a2ii.org` has been folded into CGAP’s domain structure). **③ It pairs with existing entries** — regulatory frameworks in [[iais-icp]] and [[iais-gimar]]; regulatory data in [[irdai-market-statistics]], [[philippines-insurance-commission]], [[ira-kenya]], [[acaps-morocco]] and [[ojk-insurance-statistics]]; insurance mechanisms in [[openimis]], [[bima-mcp]], [[aegis-parametric]], [[parametric-insurance-demo]] and [[agrisky-ai]]; and the protection gap and catastrophe angle in [[swiss-re-sigma]], [[climate-conditioned-cat]] and [[dfa-climate-datasets]].

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **the page title, the body text verbatim (including the 2009 start, the supervisory focus, "led by CGAP" and the Inclusive Insurance Declaration) and the collection page’s existence**, **but downloaded no tool, diagnostic or data**; **② whether A2ii’s former standalone content has been fully migrated into CGAP, and whether it retains an independent publication library, was not verified**; **③** the page notes the site uses **AI automated translation** (verbatim: "This website uses AI-powered automated translation… may not always be fully accurate"), so **non-English renderings should be treated cautiously**; **④** this entry **does not claim the site offers actuarial tools or datasets**. **Verification note**: `a2ii.org/en` (56.2KB) and `cgap.org/topics/collections/access-to-insurance-initiative` (56.2KB) were measured at HTTP 200 with body text read; **no tool or report was downloaded**.
e.body_hk:
**A2ii（Access to Insurance Initiative，保險可及性倡議）** 是**面向保險監管者的普惠保險倡議**，自 **2009 年**起運作，**現由 CGAP 主導**。本條目與 [[microinsurance-network]] 同屬本輪**普惠保險**取向——實測池內 **A2ii 與 CGAP 相關條目均為 0**。

可核實資訊（**均 HTTP 200 實測**）：**`a2ii.org/en` 實測已整站呈現為 CGAP 站點**（頁面標題實測為 **「Access to Insurance Initiative (A2ii) | CGAP」**），**正文原文**：「**A2ii works with insurance supervisors to promote inclusive and responsible insurance… Since 2009, A2ii has played a key role in disseminating knowledge, supporting peer learning…**」；頁面另出現 **「Key A2ii initiatives led by CGAP」** 與 **Championing the Inclusive Insurance Declaration… within national financial inclusion strategies**，以及 **（IAIS）**、**Innovation Lab**、**Cape Town Declaration**、**Fema-Meter**、**Regulations Map** 等具體項目名；對應集合頁 **HTTP 200（56.2KB）**。

對 RIAA：**① 補上「普惠保險的監管側」這一形態**——[[microinsurance-network]] 給**市場側與景觀研究**，A2ii 給**規則與監管能力建設側**；其**工作對象是保險監管者**，故產出多為**監管診斷、同行學習與工具**；頁面中的 **Regulations Map**、**Cape Town Declaration**、**Innovation Lab** 都是**可檢索的具體抓手**。**② 一個重要的結構性事實**：**A2ii 現已成為 CGAP 的一部分**——**引用時應寫明「A2ii（由 CGAP 主導）」**。**③ 與既有條目配套**：[[iais-icp]]、[[iais-gimar]]、[[irdai-market-statistics]]、[[philippines-insurance-commission]]、[[ira-kenya]]、[[acaps-morocco]]、[[openimis]]、[[bima-mcp]]、[[agrisky-ai]]、[[swiss-re-sigma]]。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**頁面標題、正文原文與集合頁的存在**，**但未下載任何工具、診斷報告或數據**；**② 原獨立站點內容是否已全部遷入 CGAP、是否保留獨立出版物庫，未核實**；**③** 頁面提示使用 **AI 自動翻譯**，**故非英文版本表述需謹慎**；**④** 本詞條**不主張**該站提供精算工具或數據集。**核實說明**：兩頁 HTTP 200 實測並讀取正文；**未下載任何工具或報告**。
